completion.releaseNote: Task commands need no id when you hold exactly one task; validation errors are shorter.
completion.summary: `task show`, `task complete`, `task release` and `handoff` with no id use the one task the caller holds (`heldTask` in runtime.ts); none or several refuse with exit 2 and list them. Core `parseInput` writes shorter validation text for CLI and MCP. Tests: CLI output.test.ts (held task, refusals, another agent's claim, validation text), core hardening.test.ts (message wording, issues kept). All package tests pass with a long timeout; the 5 s default timed out once in sync fuzz under machine load 38+.

title: CLI: omitted task id means the task you hold (release, complete, handoff, show); validation errors worded for people
